environment.description: AWS ECS Fargate service consuming from SQS queue. PostgreSQL 15 on RDS with application-level tenant context setting (SET app.current_tenant) but NO row-level security policies enabled on the tenant_records table. The DB role used by the service is a superuser role (rds_superuser) that bypasses any RLS policies even if they existed. SQS queue has no message attribute validation. Public key is distributed in application config and accessible to any authenticated user of the platform.

config.database: PostgreSQL 15 on RDS, role: rds_superuser, NO RLS policies on tenant_records
config.queue: SQS Standard queue, no message attribute filtering
config.network: VPC with public subnets, no WAF
config.key_distribution: RSA public key in /app/config/public.pem, also served at /.well-known/jwks.json
